entities.summary: Rostislaw Wygranienko (b. 1978-10-12, Simferopol) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Simferopol and Belarus. Known in the fields of belarus, composers & musicians, europe.
